_doc: Decision per sutra-names-a-list entry that tools/patha_inventory.py first reported missing. class: present (stored/wired) | alias (reads another gana) | derived (the engine derives it) | in-sutra (listed in the sutra) | false-positive (heuristic hit on a word with 'adi') | source-needed / laukika-numerals / open-akrti (still missing: they form docs/data/patha_missing_baseline.json). Written by hand with the Kasika evidence; checked by tests/unit/test_patha_inventory.py.

1.1.23|saMKyA words (eka … , bahu, gaRa,.why: bahu, gaRa, vatu, qati are named by the sutra (stored: data/inputs/samkhya_patha.json); -vatup / -qati words are tagged by the pratyaya at run time (5.2.39, 5.2.41); the primitive numerals (eka … sahasra …) are 'laukika' (Kasika 5.2.56) — a source of numeral stems is still needed

1.1.64|acontyAdi.why: 'aco 'ntyadi ti': positional adi (first of the final vowel-sound), not a list

1.2.1|gANkuwAdiByoYRinNit.why: kutadi = dhatupatha antargana (46 marks incl. one stray; kut 06.0093 … kun/kuun 06.0137); sutras/…/sutra_1_2_1.py reads meta['antarganas']

1.2.21|udupaDAdBAvAdikarmaRoranyatarasyA.why: 'bhavadikarmanoh': the word adi-karman, not a list

2.1.70|SramaRAdiBiH.why: gana SramaRAdiH exists; the brain filed it under 3.1.70, the overlay corrects it to 2.1.70 (Kasika 2.1.70 lists SramaRa …)

2.2.18|kugatiprAdayaH.why: prAdi = gana 1.4.58 (stored); gati by 1.4.60 ff (derived); ku is the avyaya (Kasika 2.2.18)

2.3.29|anyArAditarartedikCabdAYcUttarapa.why: the words are listed in the sutra itself (anya, arat, itara, rte, dik-sabda, anc-uttarapada, ac, ahi)

3.1.55|puzAdidyutAdyxditaH.why: pusadi / dyutadi = dhatupatha antarganas (stored per root, read by sutra_3_1_55); ldit is derived from the root's it-marker by 1.3.2

3.2.146|nindahiMsakliSaKAdavinASaparikzi.why: the roots are listed in the sutra itself

3.2.21|divAviBAniSApraBABAskArAntAnantAd.why: the words are listed in the sutra itself

3.4.46|kazAdizu.why: kasadi = the upapadas of the namul sutras from 3.4.34 (nimulasamulayoh kasah) on: read off the Astadhyayi text (Kasika 3.4.46: '3.4.34 ity etad arabhya kasadayah')

4.1.100|haritAdiByoYaH.why: haritadi = the stretch of bidadi from harita to its end (Kasika: bidadyantarganah); overlay sub_ganas

4.1.172|kurunAdiByo.why: kuru + na-kara-adi: the janapada-ksatriya names that begin with n (naisadhya, naipathya) — a letter-positional class, no list (Kasika 4.1.172)

4.1.173|sAlvAvayavapratyagraTakalakUwASm.why: the stems are listed in the sutra itself (pratyagratha, kalakuta, asmaka …)

4.1.18|lohitAdikatanteByaH.why: lohitadi up to kata = the gana of 3.1.13 (stored), read as far as kata (Kasika 4.1.18)

4.1.85|dityadityAdityapatyuttarapadARRya.why: the stems are listed in the sutra itself (diti, aditi, aditya, pati-uttarapada)

4.2.111|kaRvAdiByo.why: kanvadi = the stretch of gargadi from kanva to its end ('kanvo gargadih', Kaumudi 4.2.111); overlay sub_ganas

4.3.111|karmandakfSASvAdiniH.why: 'karmandakrsasvad inih': two stems in the sutra

4.3.88|SiSukrandayamasaBadvandvendrajana.why: indrajananadi is an akrtigana 'prayogato 'nusartavyah, pratipadikesu na pathyate' (Kasika 4.3.88): usage-attested, not in the pathas; admitted only by a reviewed extension row (gana_extensions.json, to be added)

5.2.56|viMSatyAdiByastamaqanyatarasyAm.why: vimsatyadi = laukika numeral words (Kasika 5.2.56), not a pathas list: needs the numeral source of 1.1.23

5.2.57|SatAdimAsArDamAsasaMvatsarAcca.why: satadi = laukika numeral words (Kasika 5.2.57): needs the numeral source of 1.1.23

5.3.2|kiMsarvanAmabahuByodvyAdiByaH.why: dvyadi = dvi, tri … (laukika numeral words): needs the numeral source of 1.1.23

6.1.157|pAraskarAdiH.why: pAraskarAdi: members from the brain's notes, verified in the Kasika (pAraskara kAraskara raTaspA kizku kizkinDA), gaNasutras 163/164 stored; akrtigana (Kasika 6.1.157)

6.1.188|svapAdihiMsAmacyaniwi.why: svapadi = an adadyantargana (Kaumudi 6.1.188): its first and last root are not in the sources; needs the dhatupatha's antargana mark

6.1.197|YnityAdirnityam.why: 'Yn-ityadir nityam': ñit / nit and adi (first vowel)

6.1.6|jakzityAdayaH.why: jaksityadi = dhatupatha antargana (jaks + six = 7, Kasika 6.1.6); read by sutra_6_1_6

6.2.131|vargyAdiH.why: vargyadi = the yat-forms of digadi's stretch from varga to its end (Kasika 6.2.131); the engine derives yat (4.3.54); overlay extra.derived

6.2.170|jAtikAlasuKAdiByonAcCAdanAt.why: sukhadi = the gana of 3.1.18 (Kasika 6.2.170: 'sukhadayas trtiye 3.1.18 pathyante')

6.3.2|stokAdiByaH.why: stokadi = stoka, antika-artha, dura-artha, krcchra: spelled by the sutra itself, the two middle ones by meaning (vivaksa), not a list

7.1.16|pUrvAdiByo.why: purvadi = nine of sarvadi from purva (sva, antara included); overlay sub_ganas (Kasika 7.1.16 'navabhyah')

7.1.25|qatarAdiByaH.why: qatarAdi = five of sarvadi from qatara (qatara qatama anya anyatara itara); overlay sub_ganas (Kasika 7.1.25 'paYcabhyah')

7.2.45|raDAdiByaSca.why: radhadi = dhatupatha antargana (8 roots, Kasika 7.2.45 'astabhyah'); stored per root

7.3.1|devikASiMSapAdityavAqdIrGasatraSre.why: the stems are listed in the sutra itself (devika, simsapa, ditya-vah, dirghasatra, sreyas)
